3.name: Psionic Spells & Telepathic Speech (Aberrant Sorcery)
3.description: Always have Aberrant psionic spells prepared, and link minds as a Bonus Action to communicate telepathically within 30 feet.

6.name: Psionic Sorcery (Aberrant Sorcery)
6.description: Cast Psionic Spells by spending Sorcery Points equal to the spell's level, ignoring Verbal/Somatic and non-consumed Material components.

14.name: Revelation in Flesh (Aberrant Sorcery)
14.description: Spend Sorcery Points as a Bonus Action for 10 minutes to gain See Invisibility, Fly Speed with hover, Swim Speed/water breathing, or squeeze through 1-inch spaces.

18.name: Warping Implosion (Aberrant Sorcery)
18.description: Teleport up to 120 feet as a Magic action, creating a gravity anomaly that pulls nearby creatures in for 3d10 Force damage (once per Long Rest or 5 Sorcery Points).

3.name: Clockwork Spells & Restore Balance (Clockwork Sorcery)
3.description: Always have Clockwork spells prepared, and use your Reaction to cancel Advantage or Disadvantage on a d20 Test within 60 feet.

6.name: Bastion of Law (Clockwork Sorcery)
6.description: Spend 1 to 5 Sorcery Points as a Magic action to create a ward of d8s that a creature can spend as a Reaction to reduce incoming damage.

14.name: Trance of Order (Clockwork Sorcery)
14.description: For 1 minute as a Bonus Action, attacks against you cannot benefit from Advantage and your d20 Tests treat any roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

18.name: Clockwork Cavalcade (Clockwork Sorcery)
18.description: Restore up to 100 total HP, repair objects, and end Level 6 or lower spells in a 30-foot Cube as a Magic action (once per Long Rest or 7 Sorcery Points).

bastion_of_law.name: Bastion of Law
bastion_of_law.hint: Spend 1–5 Sorcery Points for a ward of d8s reducing incoming damage via Reaction.

3.name: Draconic Resilience & Draconic Spells (Draconic Sorcery)
3.description: Your HP maximum increases by 3 (and by 1 whenever you gain another Sorcerer level), your unarmored AC equals 10 + DEX + CHA modifiers, and you always have your Draconic Spells prepared.

6.name: Elemental Affinity (Draconic Sorcery)
6.description: Gain Resistance to the damage type of your Draconic Ancestry, and add your CHA modifier to one damage roll of any spell you cast that deals that damage type.

14.name: Dragon Wings (Draconic Sorcery)
14.description: As a Bonus Action, manifest spectral dragon wings granting a Fly Speed of 60 feet for 1 hour (once per Long Rest or by spending 3 Sorcery Points).

18.name: Dragon Companion (Draconic Sorcery)
18.description: Cast Summon Dragon once per Long Rest without material components, optionally removing Concentration for a 1-minute duration.

3.name: Wild Magic Surge & Tides of Chaos (Wild Magic Sorcery)
3.description: Trigger Wild Magic Surge effects after leveled Sorcerer spells and claim Advantage on one d20 Test via Tides of Chaos.

6.name: Bend Luck (Wild Magic Sorcery)
6.description: Use your Reaction and spend 1 Sorcery Point to roll 1d4 and add or subtract it from another creature's d20 Test within 30 feet.

14.name: Controlled Chaos (Wild Magic Sorcery)
14.description: Roll twice on the Wild Magic Surge table whenever you trigger a surge and choose either outcome.

18.name: Tamed Surge (Wild Magic Sorcery)
18.description: Once per Long Rest, pick any non-self-buff effect from the Wild Magic Surge table immediately after casting a Sorcerer spell with a spell slot.

bend_luck.name: Bend Luck
bend_luck.hint: Reaction + 1 Sorcery Point: add or subtract 1d4 from another creature's d20 Test within 30 ft.
